_comment: Owner competition rules that make a manager ineligible to WIN one award in ONE season of ONE league. Eligibility only: the underlying metric is still measured, published and ranked (metric rank), and no other award, statistic, standings or data consumer reads this file. Scoped by season + that season's Sleeper league id, never by date, so a past season keeps its rule forever and a new season starts with none. Owner module: src/public_league/award_eligibility.py.
